namespace = vmore

scripted_trigger v_inline_trigger = {
	is_adult = yes
}

vmore.1 = {
	type = character_event
	title = v.1.t
	trigger = {
		v_inline_trigger = yes
		NOT = { v_rule_trigger = yes }
		gold >= define:NWar|WAR_COST
		has_trait = trait:brave
	}
	immediate = {
		v_gift_effect = yes
		character:186004 = { add_trait = craven }
		culture:norse = { save_scope_as = old_culture }
		title:e_y = { save_scope_as = far_title }
		title:k_y = { save_scope_as = near_title }
	}
	option = {
		name = v.1.a
		add_gold = 1
	}
}
vmore.2 = {
	type = character_event
	title = v.2.t
	option = {
		name = v.2.a
		add_gold = 2
	}
}
